description: Directed value, information, and operating exchanges in the Solvari-specific model.

relations.name: Shares project context and receives a response
relations.description: Only authorized recipient professionals receive the details needed to discuss the project.

relations.name: Agrees the work directly
relations.description: Homeowner and professional form any work agreement directly; Solvari provides the matching context.

relations.name: Assigns demand budget and follow-up responsibility
relations.description: The buyer sets acquisition limits; the coordinator supplies known outcomes for value review.

relations.name: Raises lead-quality evidence
relations.description: The coordinator reports unreachable, duplicate, or unsuitable contacts with context.

relations.name: Explains commercial corrections
relations.description: Authorized case decisions reconcile platform charges and credits, not homeowner construction payments.

relations.name: Introduces the matching offer
relations.description: Partner content explains the handoff and data sharing before a request is sent.

relations.name: Supplies attributable demand
relations.description: Partner requests carry source and permission context for qualification.

relations.name: Resolves partner settlement exceptions
relations.description: Operators explain acceptance and correction evidence; settlement follows the effective partner agreement.

relations.name: Provides experience feedback or requests review
relations.description: The homeowner reports actual contact or work experience and can challenge an explained marketplace decision.
